column1: # Compressed-pixel-data samples, one line per file: the minimum needed to build and test a decoder
# for every transfer syntax SlicerAlbula should read. Small, public, MIT-licensed files from the
# pydicom project (pinned: pydicom v3.0.1 and pydicom-data abc42b90). Where a lossless file has an
# UNCOMPRESSED SIBLING, that sibling is the pixel-exact truth a decoder test compares against.

column5: CT 512x512 12-bit, 1 frame (a trailing bad sequence: the parser must cope)
CT 512x512, 1 frame; its header says BitsStored 16 while the truth file says 14 -- the codestream's own precision decides (a known trap)
CT 512x512 13-bit; the codestream says signed, the header says unsigned (a known trap)
